description: This PHP source file defines the AdminWorkshopEditForm class, a form processor for editing workshop details in an admin interface of the Goteo platform. It includes form fields for various workshop attributes such as title, description, location, date, and type, and handles form creation and saving logic.

classes.name: AdminWorkshopEditForm
classes.description: A form processor class for editing workshops in the admin interface, extending AbstractFormProcessor with methods to create and save the form.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes and adds form fields for editing workshop details such as title, description, location, dates, and other attributes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates form data and saves updates to the workshop model, including handling header images and associated location data.

methods.name: getWorkshopsChoices
methods.description: Retrieves a list of event type choices for the workshop form.
